operations.name: CNC Turn – First End
operations.setup_note: Locate purchased bushing 839310 on the outer tube's own axis using supported, protected split soft jaws; do not assume that this axis coincides with the bar-pin axis. Face the first F06 tube end and finish its exposed cylindrical land only where the supplied condition leaves machining stock, retaining the approved end-curl blank geometry.

operations.name: CNC Turn – Second End
operations.setup_note: Reverse the bushing in supported soft jaws, locating on the first finished tube land and its axial reference without loading the rubber bond. Face and finish the opposite F06 terminal land to the approved pre-curl geometry; leave already conforming supplied surfaces untouched.

operations.name: VMC – Flats, Interrupted Profile and Mounting Holes
operations.setup_note: Clamp the accessible bar-pin metal in one purpose-built indexed fixture, locating from supplied metal seating surfaces and axial stops after the front-view frame has been registered. Mill the opposed flats and only the surviving internal circular arcs, then spot and drill both transverse mounting holes; fixture indexing provides the required access directions without unclamping the part.

operations.name: Cold Form – Outer Tube End Curls
operations.setup_note: Support the F06 tube directly in a dedicated opposed-die fixture with axial stops, keeping forming loads out of the bar pin and bonded rubber. Cold-form both tube ends to the specified radiused configuration, final tube length and end position after the end-diameter interpretation and supplied forming condition are approved.

operations.name: Cylindrical Grind – Called-Out Ground Surface
operations.setup_note: Provisionally support and drive the bar pin through accessible metal end surfaces, using a dressed wheel for the approved F04 contour while shielding the tube and elastomer. Grind only F04 to its specified diameter limits after its accessibility, axial span and correspondence to the drawing's ground-surface note are confirmed.

operations.name: Production Bench – Deburr, Clean and Mark
operations.setup_note: Support the completed bushing in a protected bench nest for one fast production pass removing detrimental flash, machining burrs and grinding residue without hand-polishing. Apply PATENT NO. 5122011 at the approved nonfunctional metal marking location.

operations.name: Batch Phosphate and Ground-Surface Oil
operations.setup_note: Protect the elastomer and provisionally ground F04 surface, then process the 100-piece order on the in-house phosphate line in validated rack loads, splitting the order if rack capacity requires. After rinsing, drying and unmasking, apply the specified light oil coat per PS-123.0 to the confirmed ground surface while the parts remain in the process carrier.

operations.name: Final Shop-Floor Gauge and Sampled Test Gate
operations.setup_note: Locate the finished bushing in dedicated shop-floor gauges for selected critical dimensions and visual checks of the bond, phosphate coverage, oil, marking and safe edges. Include any TS-839310-required sampled functional testing in this same final quality gate through the in-house test lab, using the approved method and sampling plan.

clarifications.question: At what manufacturing stage is bushing 839310 supplied?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use purchased bushing 839310, not raw stock; the provisional completion route assumes that the scheduled metal features remain accessible and have residual machining or forming allowance.

clarifications.question: Which feature is identified by the drawing note 'O.T. GROUND SURFACE'?
clarifications.suggested_default: Provisionally use F04 because it is the only feature explicitly described as ground; do not add grinding to F06 without confirmation.

clarifications.question: What registered orientation maps the front-view F01 and F02 geometry into the Section A-A coordinate frame?
What is the axial depth of the interrupted internal profile F02?
What is the specified axial span of the ground F04 surface?
What axial contour is required on F04?
clarifications.suggested_default: Treat F04 as cylindrical according to its extracted feature type; do not invent a spherical radius or barrel contour.

clarifications.question: Does the 2X diameter range 57.6–59.6 mm control the inside or outside diameter of the F06 formed ends?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use the extracted outside-diameter interpretation provisionally; the upstream inner-diameter assumption is not adopted.

clarifications.question: What material specifications apply to the metal components of bushing 839310?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use medium-machinability ferrous substrates for provisional planning only.

clarifications.question: What as-supplied hardness applies to the metal components of bushing 839310?
Is post-machining phosphating of the intact bonded bushing approved?
Can you provide the controlled TS-839310 acceptance specification?
clarifications.suggested_default: Plan dedicated dimensional gauges and visual checks; perform functional testing only using a TS-approved method and sampling plan.

assumptions.text: MAKE FROM BUSHING: 839310 requires purchased starting hardware. No bar-stock manufacture, forging, tube fabrication, rubber molding or new bonding operation is assumed; saw cutting, flat-blank cutting and parting-off are omitted.

This is a provisional completion route, not authority to recut finished purchased features. Scheduled machining assumes clean, near-net supplied metal surfaces with only residual finish stock; bulk rough turning, rough boring and pocket clearing are therefore omitted pending confirmation of the incoming condition.

No heat treatment is specified or added. Medium machinability and unknown hardness are provisional; the explicit ground callout and ALM-IC-007 override the grinding template's hardened-only restriction.

No drawing datum letters are established. Workholding uses existing metal surfaces and process stops; revision markers are not datums, and the view-local axes and the F04/F06 centerlines are not silently registered.

Exactly two lathe setups complete opposite F06 ends, with facing retained as a real step. No unlisted bar-pin end diameter is invented, and lathe center drilling is omitted because the provisional fixtures provide support without requiring new center holes.

F02 remains an internal feature as extracted and is assumed pre-opened. Arc-only profile milling preserves the intersecting F01 flats; full-circle boring could erase those flats and is not routed. The flats are provisionally treated as coextensive with the confirmed internal-profile depth.

F05 is treated as a shallow clearance-hole pair suitable for spotting and drilling within its stated diameter range. No pilot drilling, deep-hole peck cycle, reaming, honing, tapping, countersinking, counterboring or spotfacing is supported by the supplied callouts; separate milling datum-face, pocket and slot steps are also unnecessary.

F06 radiused ends are provisionally cold-curled with dedicated press tooling, not cut as solid-stock radii. Only the forming portion of the sheet-metal template applies; punching new sheet features, hardware insertion, welding and weld dressing are omitted.

Only one cylindrical grinding operation is routed, provisionally on F04. Face, ID and flat grinding, separate profile grinding, lapping and superfinishing are omitted; neither the F04 ground span nor the F02 depth is inferred from unrelated diameter or tube-length dimensions.

One production deburr/clean bench pass follows all machining and forming. Phosphate preparation, masking, rinsing, drying and oil application remain within one coating operation; protective masking precedes chemical cleaning to protect the bonded elastomer. The ground area is left unphosphated under the localized OD-grind exception, subject to specification approval.

No coating cure or embrittlement-relief bake is assumed without a specification requirement; any required relief must remain within the coating operation and be validated for the bonded assembly. Separate coating and grinding inspection gates are replaced by the single final manual-inspection gate.

The generic outside_process sub-operation denotes in-house light oil application in operation 7 and the TS-defined sampled functional check in operation 8 because the vocabulary has no exact types for those tasks. It does not denote subcontracting, oil impregnation, a pressure test or an assumed crush test; sampling remains subject to TS-839310.
